wins: Mapped initial network perimeter and identified open TCP services via recon scripts prior to time-out.
Documented service banners allowing for faster hypothesis generation despite no final success.
fails: Failed to progress past userland foothold due to missing credential validation and ineffective exploitation attempts.
Repeated dependence on default payloads without tailoring to observed service versions led to zero successful engagements.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance stage completed but execution stalled in exploitation due to insufficiently tailored payloads and no credential acquisition.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Exploitation attempts repeatedly aborted on known service ports because payload signatures did not match observed banner versions.

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH port 22 is open and the banner indicates OpenSSH 8.x
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted SSH enumeration with nmap --script ssh-auth-methods,ssh2-enum-algos and hydra for password spraying.

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service returns outdated banner and directory listing accessible
skill_cards.then_action: Deploy gobuster with wordlist medium for directories then follow up with curl to enumerate config files.

skill_cards.if_condition: When SMB port 445 open but no credentials validated
skill_cards.then_action: Use crackmapexec --local-auth to identify valid shares and then run enum4linux for ACL enumeration.

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in reconnaissance phase when SSH services respond with detailed banners.
Consistent directory discovery delivered actionable insights despite lack of final compromise.

next_experiments.title: Tailored exploitation payloads for observed service versions
next_experiments.description: Develop and test custom exploit modules for the specific service versions discovered during reconnaissance (e.g., patched OpenSSH 8.x) instead of relying on defaults.

next_experiments.title: Credential harvesting via aggressive service enumeration
next_experiments.description: Integrate Hydra and crackmapexec sequentially to confirm usable account credentials immediately after identification of accessible services.

next_experiments.title: Automated post-scan decision tree
next_experiments.description: Create a script that parses nmap output and triggers the appropriate skill card actions (SSH, SMB, HTTP) to reduce decision latency.
